_comment: Each arXiv query casts a wide net; a find is kept only if its title or abstract matches at least one term from every list in 'must'. Citing papers of entries with track_citations are kept if they mention any citation_term.

arxiv.name: Payment code written by AI
arxiv.query: (abs:payment OR abs:payments OR abs:checkout OR abs:webhook OR abs:webhooks) AND (abs:"coding agent" OR abs:"coding agents" OR abs:"code generation" OR abs:"generated code" OR abs:"LLM-generated" OR abs:"AI-generated")

arxiv.name: Payment and e-commerce logic flaws
arxiv.query: (abs:payment OR abs:payments OR abs:"e-commerce" OR abs:merchant OR abs:checkout) AND (abs:"logic vulnerability" OR abs:"logic vulnerabilities" OR abs:"logic flaw" OR abs:"logic flaws" OR abs:"business logic") AND (abs:security OR abs:secure OR abs:attack OR abs:attacks OR abs:vulnerability OR abs:vulnerabilities)

arxiv.name: Webhook security
arxiv.query: (abs:webhook OR abs:webhooks) AND (abs:security OR abs:secure OR abs:attack OR abs:attacks OR abs:vulnerability OR abs:vulnerabilities)

arxiv.name: Agentic commerce security
arxiv.query: (abs:"agentic commerce" OR abs:"agent payments" OR abs:"agentic payments" OR abs:"agent payment") AND (abs:security OR abs:secure OR abs:attack OR abs:attacks OR abs:vulnerability OR abs:vulnerabilities)

arxiv.name: Security of AI-generated code
arxiv.query: (cat:cs.CR OR cat:cs.SE) AND (abs:"generated code" OR abs:"secure code generation" OR abs:"code security") AND abs:benchmark AND (abs:agent OR abs:agents OR abs:LLM OR abs:LLMs)

arxiv.name: Tool-using agents: failures, idempotency and tool selection
arxiv.query: (abs:"tool calling" OR abs:"tool use" OR abs:"function calling" OR abs:"tool-using" OR abs:MCP OR abs:"Model Context Protocol") AND (abs:agent OR abs:agents) AND (abs:idempotency OR abs:idempotent OR abs:retry OR abs:retries OR abs:duplicate OR abs:"non-atomic" OR abs:"tool selection" OR abs:"tool description" OR abs:"tool descriptions" OR abs:"tool preference" OR abs:payment OR abs:payments)
